description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Training Steps and BPC, comparing two lines representing different data sets. The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps," has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 50, and is multiplied by 10^3, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "BPC," also has a linear scale and ranges from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The black line with star markers and solid style represents one data set, starting at approximately 1.7 BPC at 0 training steps and decreasing to around 1.2 BPC at 50,000 training steps, with a notable decline between 0 and 20,000 steps, from 1.7 to 1.25 BPC. The magenta line with star markers and solid style represents the "SimSMoE Validating" data, beginning at around 2.15 BPC at 0 training steps and decreasing to approximately 1.1 BPC at 50,000 training steps, also showing a significant drop between 0 and 20,000 steps, from 2.15 to 1.2 BPC.
